title: Yeti Summit Series Apricot Watermelon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Apricot Watermelon from Yeti Summit Series delivers a refreshing and juicy combination of ripe, sweet Apricot and the vibrant, mouth-watering taste of Watermelon. With each inhale, the rich, succulent flavours of Apricot are perfectly balanced by the crisp, refreshing sweetness of Watermelon, while an icy Menthol finish on the exhale leaves you feeling revitalised. Shortfill bottles provide an excellent way to customise your nicotine levels. This 100ml bottle of nicotine-free e-liquid has space for 20ml of nicotine shots, allowing you to create the perfect nicotine strength for your needs. To make 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots, shake well, and your e-liquid is ready to vape. Shortfills are a cost-effective and convenient option for vapers who enjoy larger quantities of their favourite flavours. With their higher VG content, shortfills are ideal for use with high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, delivering maximum flavour and dense vapour production. Save time and money by stocking up on Yeti Summit shortfills. Discover the Yeti Summit range, crafted by UK-based e-liquid masters Prohibition. Yeti Summit offers a super-frosty collection of flavours that blend authentic fruit profiles with a bracing layer of crisp, icy menthol, for maximum flavour and refreshment.
